scope: Offline-only strict-OOS comparison of the paired MC1 residual mapper control against causal S/R inputs, a retrained all-candidate 15-minute E2 input, and both. No live, canonical, execution, policy, or frozen model artifact changed.

causality.candidate_and_portfolio_contract: All four arms retain the same target-free candidate stream, labels, paired residual target, residual clipping, dual >=30 admission, BCF-priority top-two route, portfolio replay and one-time 100-bps policy cost.
causality.sr_inputs: Only causal_sr_heads_oof_20260830_v3_entrypivotfix is accepted; oracle/noncausal paths are rejected. Missing S/R remains a LightGBM feature plus availability indicator and never alters eligibility.
causality.e2_inputs: The new E2-15m input is a fresh non-pairwise all-candidate 70-feature L1 policy-net model. Its held score is fit on outer prior-resolved rows. Each nonmissing MC1 training feature is an inner prediction fit strictly before that row's month; no same-row label calibration is an MC1 feature.
causality.labels: The immutable rich-policy label source is read identically for every arm. Unreadable parts are excluded by whole symbol from every compared arm and never imputed or replaced.
causality.execution: All runs are offline and no exchange-writing or live execution path is invoked.

commands: repeat identical run comparison: portfolio_summary row equality true, maximum numeric delta 0.0
post-run target-free audit: no duplicate selected IDs, at most two selections per timestamp, no policy or label fields in selections, all held E2 scores finite
validation.results: Focused tests: 6 passed. Jun-Aug portfolio OOS: S/R alone improves control from +9.27 to +38.84 bps/trade; E2-15m alone reaches +10.21 bps/trade; S/R+E2-15m reaches +36.09 bps/trade and is inferior to S/R alone. No promotion or live change.
